message: Strapping pin: GPIO 2 must be LOW during boot for flash programming.
`HCSR04` needs 2 pins (echo, trig) but the declaration only provides one. Missing: echo, trig.
hint: Use the named-pins syntax: `device hcsr04: HCSR04(echo: <gpio>, trig: <gpio>)`
